title: 先把他们送出去

source.prompt: Original instrumental retro fantasy tactical RPG score. Clear memorable NEW melody, compact four-voice counterpoint, warm pulse-wave lead, rounded triangle bass, gentle acoustic chamber colors, restrained noise percussion, clean mobile-speaker mix. No vocals, no choir, no speech, no lyrics; no quotation or imitation of any existing melody. 124 BPM, nimble tactical march for protecting villagers on forest roads and recovering grain. Crisp pulse-wave melody, active bass, short question-and-answer phrases, modest snare rhythm. Alert and courageous, steady intensity for long tactical decisions, no cinematic drops. Maintain steady repeating musical phrases throughout, no long introduction, no fade-out or final ending.
source.negative_prompt: vocals, singing, speech, lyrics, choir, crowd, harsh distortion, loud sound effects, abrupt stop

editing.method: four-bar-multiple pulse alignment and two-beat chroma/timbre/energy window search; cosine equal-gain overlap

rhythm.note: Algorithmic pulse estimate; musical beat/meter and perceived loop coherence require listening.
